sections.executive_summary: US CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper conducted a high-level coordination visit to Israel, meeting with IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and Mossad chief Roman Gopman to align on Iranian threats and joint operational readiness. Simultaneously, Iranian air defense activity in Isfahan and UAV movements over East Azerbaijan and Khuzestan provinces signaled heightened Iranian military alertness. In Lebanon, Israeli artillery struck Wadi al-Hujeir while warplanes operated over the south, and the Lebanese army received a second warning of a planned Israeli explosion in Zoutar al-Sharqiyya. (Source: @manniefabian/59545, @amitsegal/67382, @shin_persian/12562, @shin_persian/12561, @shin_persian/12563, @redlinkleb/53837, @redlinkleb/53772)

points: Monitoring channels reported air defense activity in Isfahan Province, Iran, indicating possible aerial engagement or alert status; the report was delayed 120 seconds via the FromIran platform. (Source: @shin_persian/12562)
Two unmanned aerial vehicles were observed over Jolfa and Hadishahr in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran, at 22:37 local time (1907Z), per delayed monitoring. (Source: @shin_persian/12561)
A UAV launched from Omidiyeh Fifth Fighter Air Base in Khuzestan Province, Iran, per delayed monitoring via FromIran. (Source: @shin_persian/12563)

Mossad chief Roman Gopman and former minister Ron Dermer advocated for joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran during Washington meetings, presenting intelligence on the Iranian nuclear program to the CIA Director. (Source: @yediotnews25/138149)

US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin stated Iranian cyber actors attacked US infrastructure across transportation, energy, and water sectors, with attacks increasing. (Source: @yediotnews25/138148)
Gulf state leaders requested President Trump avoid attacking Iran due to fears of Iranian retaliatory strikes against their territories. (Source: @yediotnews25/138154)

Iranian media reported a US Air Force C-17 medical evacuation aircraft (BNDGE01) flew from Germany to Baghdad and returned toward Europe, allegedly to evacuate US wounded from strikes in Bahrain and Kuwait; US has not confirmed casualties or evacuation. (Source: @yediotnews25/138156)

US CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper met IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and Mossad chief Roman Gopman in Tel Aviv for a triple meeting discussing regional developments, strategic cooperation, and joint readiness for various scenarios. (Source: @manniefabian/59545, @amitsegal/67382)
